scheme_name: Namo Shetkari Maha Sanman Nidhi Yojana
description: A state government initiative created to supplement PM-KISAN by providing an additional annual financial grant to landholding farmers across Maharashtra to support seasonal cultivation costs.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year distributed in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into the beneficiary's bank account (combining with PM-KISAN for a total of ₹12,000/year).
eligibility: Registered and active beneficiaries of PM-KISAN
Valid Aadhaar-linked bank account with AEPS enabled

description: A World Bank-assisted project focused on promoting climate-resilient agriculture in drought-prone and climate-vulnerable districts (specifically Marathwada and Vidarbha) through water management, soil health, and sustainable farming.
benefits: 75% to 100% financial subsidies on drip/sprinkler irrigation, farm ponds, shade net houses, and organic soil conditioners.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers in notified climate-vulnerable villages of Maharashtra
documents: Caste Certificate (if applicable for higher subsidy tier)

description: Ensures that every eligible farmer who requests a farm pond receives financial assistance to construct one, assisting in rainwater harvesting and drought mitigation.
benefits: Direct capital grant subsidy of up to ₹50,000 for constructing lined farm ponds.
eligibility: Farmers owning a minimum of 0.60 hectares of land
Feasible location for rainwater storage on land

scheme_name: Magel Tyala Saur Krishi Pump Yojana
description: Provides off-grid solar-powered irrigation pumps to farmers, ensuring reliable daytime power supply for crop irrigation and reducing reliance on conventional power grids.
benefits: Up to 90% to 95% subsidy on 3 HP, 5 HP, and 7.5 HP solar agriculture pump sets; farmers pay only 5% to 10% of total cost.
eligibility: Farmers with valid land records and access to a permanent water source (well/borewell)
Farmers without existing grid electricity connections for irrigation
documents: No-Objection Certificate (NOC) for shared water source if applicable

scheme_name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana
description: Targeted scheme aimed at socio-economic uplifting of Scheduled Caste (SC) and Neo-Buddhist farmers by upgrading their land infrastructure, irrigation capacity, and farm electrification.
benefits: Subsidies up to ₹4 Lakh for new wells, ₹1 Lakh for well repairs, and 100% subsidies for micro-irrigation and pump sets.
eligibility: Farmers belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Neo-Buddhist categories in Maharashtra

description: A dedicated welfare scheme created for Scheduled Tribe (ST) farmers to improve agricultural production through irrigation assets, micro-irrigation, and soil treatment grants.
benefits: Subsidies up to ₹2.5 Lakh for new dug wells, along with additional grants for pump sets, plastic lining for farm ponds, and power connection setup.
eligibility: Farmers belonging to Scheduled Tribe (ST) community residing in Maharashtra

scheme_name: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Shetkari Karj Mukti Yojana
description: Provides crop loan waivers to distressed farmers across Maharashtra who have overdue short-term crop loans, relieving their financial burden and restoring credit eligibility.
benefits: Direct loan waiver of up to ₹2 Lakh for short-term crop loans, directly settling accounts with participating banks.
eligibility: Farmers who took short-term crop loans from scheduled or cooperative banks in Maharashtra
Overdue or defaulted loan accounts meeting state cutoff criteria
application_mode: CSC Centers / Bank Branches (Aadhaar Biometric Verification)

description: Encourages farm mechanization by providing subsidies on tractors, power tillers, rotavators, harvest equipment, and spray drones through a transparent lottery system.
benefits: 40% to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹2.4 Lakh for mini-tractors and equipment; up to ₹4 Lakh for agricultural drones to FPOs).
eligibility: Individual farmers, Women farmers, SC/ST farmers, and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)
Must not have received equipment subsidy in the past 10 years

description: Provides financial aid to rural, landless, and marginal farmers for setting up small-scale livestock units (milch cows, goats, and poultry) to generate supplementary household income.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on purchasing indigenous/crossbred milch cows, goat/sheep rearing units (10+1 breed units), or 100 day-old chicks setups.
eligibility: BPL families, landless agricultural laborers, women SHGs, and small landholders in rural Maharashtra
application_mode: Online via Department of Animal Husbandry Portal

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY - Organic Cluster Grant)
description: Promotes organic farming practices through cluster-based models by supporting vermicomposting, bio-fertilizer infrastructure, and organic certification for high-value export crops.
benefits: Financial aid of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for cluster farmers (covering vermicompost units, organic inputs, and PGS certification).
eligibility: Farmers willing to form clusters of a minimum 50 members and convert land to organic farming
application_mode: Group Application via District Agriculture Officer
